title: map_script can cause Elasticsearch process to crash
body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): `Version: 7.10.0, Build: default/tar/51e9d6f22758d0374a0f3f5c6e8f3a7997850f96/2020-11-09T21:30:33.964949Z, JVM: 15.0.1`

**Plugins installed**: []

**JVM version** (`java -version`): `JVM: 15.0.1`

**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system): `Darwin MacBook-Pro.localdomain 19.6.0 Darwin Kernel Version 19.6.0: Mon Aug 31 22:12:52 PDT 2020; root:xnu-6153.141.2~1/RELEASE_X86_64 x86_64`

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

The below `map_script` causes the Elasticsearch process to crash/exit due to the `return` statement.

(Note: the `return` statement is not necessary-- the script will work fine if it's omitted).

**Steps to reproduce**:

```
GET myindex/_search
{
  "aggregations": {
    "myagg": {
      "scripted_metric": {
        "init_script": {
          "source": "state.mystring=''",
          "lang": "painless"
        },
        "map_script": {
          "source": "state.mystring= params._source.foo; return state.mystring;",
          "lang": "painless"
        },
        "combine_script": {
          "source": "return state.mystring;",
          "lang": "painless"
        },
        "reduce_script": {
          "source": "return states[0];",
          "lang": "painless"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
